stories.title: Token Schema and Persistence Contract
stories.description: Define and implement the token storage schema including fields for token_id, hashed_token, issued_at, expires_at, rotation_version, and revoked_flag. Ensure compatibility with existing MongoDB utilities and authentication flows.
stories.evidence: Code/Shared/brain_auth.py; Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; Code/Shared/ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py; GAP: No unified lifecycle-aware token schema exists

stories.title: Token Expiration Enforcement Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic to validate token expiration using expires_at timestamp during authentication checks. Deny access for expired tokens and ensure consistent handling across all entry points.
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; GAP: Expiration validation not currently enforced

stories.title: Token Rotation Mechanism
stories.description: Implement token rotation logic that issues a new token, increments rotation_version, invalidates prior active token, and ensures atomic update to prevent race conditions.
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; Code/Shared/brain_auth.py; GAP: No rotation mechanism currently implemented

stories.title: Authentication Middleware Contract Update
stories.description: Refactor authentication middleware to enforce full lifecycle validation (expiration, revocation, rotation version) and standardize error responses for invalid tokens.
